name: manual_79ba3f
claim: When cleaning up a launched process tree, never reap the group leader before signalling the process group: reaping frees the pid so the group can no longer be addressed safely and a grandchild holding the pipes can outlive the cycle. Start the child in its own session, arm cleanup immediately after Popen, SIGKILL the group first, then do a bounded reap; if no exit probe exists on the platform, fail closed before starting the child.
